newsitem.title: USA: Mendik Co plans Q1 '97 initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: Mendik Co plans Q1 '97 initial public offering.

text.p: Mendik Co Inc said on Monday it planned to file, in the near future, a registration statement for an initial public offering of its common stock.
The offering is expected to occur in the first quarter of 1997, the company said.

It said the purpose of the IPO was to facilitate the formation of a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) to continue the business of Mendik Realty Co Inc and its affiliates of acquiring, owning and operating office properties in Manhattan.
